The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S15|Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Partial collections== Three ''Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies'' DVD sets were released between 2013-2014 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}, containing the whole season between them. The first sets contain two discs each, while the third set contains four discs. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Set 1=== [[File:BW Rival Destinies DVD 1.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Set 1]] Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Set 1 was released on September 10, 2013. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Unova}}; border: 2px solid #{{colorschemedark|Unova}}" !
